title: Kevin Kline Joins Meryl Streep in Netflix's The Corrections
excerpt:
The Oscar winners reunite for Jonathan Franzen's adaptation.
Cord Jefferson will direct every episode.
body_md:
Kevin Kline will play Alfred Lambert, husband to Meryl Streep's Enid. A once-authoritative patriarch, Alfred faces the challenges of aging and a changing relationship with his three adult children.

The limited drama offers a comic portrait of a Midwestern family. Enid wants one final Christmas gathering, while her children struggle with ambitions and personal problems that undermine their efforts to avoid becoming their parents.

The casting reunites Kline and Streep more than four decades after Sophie's Choice, Kline's feature debut. They subsequently collaborated on A Prairie Home Companion, Ricki and the Flash and stage productions.

Jonathan Franzen adapted his National Book Award-winning novel and executive produces. American Fiction filmmaker Cord Jefferson will direct every episode. Mark Roybal, Paul Lee, Nicole Clemens, Amy Sayres and Streep also executive produce.

Kline is an Oscar and three-time Tony winner whose recent credits include Disclaimer and American Classic. Netflix has not announced a premiere date.
